  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Separate lookup hash ticks from parser hash ticks",
      "body": "The 4,306/40,553 headline combines query-hash work with the parser's shared `hashCode` helper: line 1088 contributes 432 ticks, while parser call sites 407/408 contribute 3 ticks and the query loop line 1092 contributes 3,758 ticks. Report the 9.266% loop attribution (plus the 1090/251 query-side ticks) separately; otherwise the evidence overstates the attributable lookup operation, even though the dedicated loop still clears the 5% screening gate.",
      "priority": 2,
      "confidence": 0.98,
      "file_path": "/tmp/stax-attribute-hash-20260913/lookup-headroom-source-ticks.json",
      "line_start": 3,
      "line_end": 33
    },
    {
      "title": "Do not use duplicate-span counts as query fallback timing",
      "body": "`counterfactual-counts.json` records 10,089,666 direct span characters for 560,537 parser duplicate candidates, not the comparisons that a hash-free `attributeValue(name)` lookup would execute. It demonstrates existing duplicate-check work and a possible parser-side comparison blocker, but cannot establish a lookup candidate's speedup or payback; a lookup-specific implementation still needs end-to-end timing with the exact checksum-preserving query workload.",
      "priority": 1,
      "confidence": 0.99,
      "file_path": "/tmp/stax-attribute-hash-20260913/counterfactual-counts.json",
      "line_start": 59,
      "line_end": 65
    }
  ],
  "overall_correctness": "correct",
  "explanation": "The new lookup profile changes the decision for the public name-lookup path: its dedicated hashString loop is 3,758/40,553 = 9.266% source-attributed samples, and the full hash-related attribution is 10.618%, so a lookup-specific candidate clears the >=5% screening gate. The parser-wide scan remains only 349/26,378 = 1.323%; duplicate-span counts are not a causal speed bound, so proceed only with a narrowly scoped lookup experiment and measure its end-to-end result rather than implementing H1A wholesale.",
  "confidence": 0.97
}
